data.one_liner: BottomNavigationBar, IndexedStack, and TabController that use item keys instead of indexes.
data.what_it_does: Provides replacements for BottomNavigationBar, IndexedStack, TabController, TabBar, and TabBarView that use item keys (such as enums) instead of numeric indexes. This eliminates the need for manual index-to-meaning conversions and helps avoid range errors.
use_when: You want to use enums or meaningful keys for tabs and navigation stacks instead of magic numbers.
You need to change the set of tabs or navigation items dynamically without re-creating controllers.
avoid_when: You strictly require traditional numeric index-based tab and stack handling.
You are using SingleTickerProviderStateMixin and need to change keys dynamically (TickerProviderStateMixin must be used instead).
strengths: Allows mutable tabs and animation durations on controllers without recreation.
Supports DefaultKeyedTabController for cleaner widget trees.
weaknesses: Requires TickerProviderStateMixin instead of SingleTickerProviderStateMixin for controllers that change keys.
Does not check at compile time that the default controller is present in the tree.
